info.title: NEPSE All Scraper API
info.description:
Free, static JSON API for 365 NEPSE-listed companies. Updated every weekday after market close. Backed by flat files on GitHub Pages — no auth, no rate limits, CDN-cached.

**Note:** Symbols with `/` (e.g. `GBILD86/87`) use `-` in URLs (`GBILD86-87`) because filesystems don't allow `/` in folder names.
